definitions.explanation: Being unable to go out or proceed due to weather, transportation problems, or other circumstances. Also used for deliberately preventing someone from leaving.

examples.japanese: {大雪|おおゆき}で{足止|あしど}めされた。
examples.english: I was stranded by heavy snow.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{空港|くうこう}に{足止|あしど}めを{食|く}らった。
examples.english: I was stuck at the airport due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{運休|うんきゅう}で{多|おお}くの{乗客|じょうきゃく}が{駅|えき}で{足止|あしど}めされている。
examples.english: Many passengers are stranded at the station due to train suspensions.

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
- {足止|あしど}めされる: to be stranded
- {足止|あしど}めを{食|く}らう: to get stuck (colloquial)
- {足止|あしど}めを{食|く}う: to get stuck
